uncited: **Pre-processing:** Acquire head poses and expression weights for each frame.
Convert rigid head poses to camera poses to map observations to a canonical head pose.
**Initialization:** Initialize 3D Gaussian centers $\mu$ with 2500 points (subset of 3DMM mesh vertices or random points within near/far bounds).
The MLP $\phi$ consists of two linear layers with LeakyReLU activations, a hidden layer of 64 channels, and two output branches (color and opacity).
**Projection:** Project Gaussians to image space using camera view $W_i$.
**Rendering:** Render using a tile-based differentiable rasterizer.
